parameters.name: AllocationId
parameters.description: The ID of the EIP instance. You can specify up to 50 IDs, separated by commas.

parameters.name: AssociatedInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the associated cloud service instance.

parameters.name: AssociatedInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the cloud service instance to associate with the EIP. Valid values:

- **EnsInstance**: an ENS instance of the VPC type.

- **SlbInstance**: an SLB instance.

parameters.name: EipAddress
parameters.description: The IP address of the EIP. You can specify up to 50 IP addresses, separated by commas.

parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the ENS node.

parameters.name: EnsRegionIds
parameters.description: An array of 1 to 100 ENS node IDs.

parameters.name: IcmpReplyEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable ICMP reply. Valid values:

- **true** (default): enabled

- **false**: disabled

parameters.name: LockReason
parameters.description:
The reason the EIP is locked.

- **financial**: The EIP is locked due to an overdue payment.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: Standby
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the EIP is a standby EIP. Valid values:

- **true**: The EIP is a standby EIP.

- **false**: The EIP is not a standby EIP.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the EIP. Valid values: Associating, Unassociating, InUse, and Available.
